title: 梦落空羽
description: 这是一个原版生存服务器，同时，我们还具备有副本服，可以体验到打怪的乐趣
body:
# Server DreamsFeather 梦落空羽服务器
## Why choose our server 为什么选择梦落空羽服务器
- We have achieved extremely low lag and support for multiple redstone mods even on non-Fabric servers, enhancing the player experience on the server. Additionally, we have added the AllMusic mod, allowing players to listen to songs requested by others during gameplay, bringing joy to the sometimes monotonous survival experience. Welcome to play on the DreamsFeather server.
- 我们在非fabric服务端的情况下，实现了极低卡顿以及多生电mod支持组，提升玩家在服务器上的游戏体验。此外，同时加入了AllMusic模组，让玩家在游戏过程中可以聆听他人点播的歌曲，为有时单调的生存体验增添乐趣。欢迎选择梦落空羽服务器游玩
## Usage Statement 使用声明
- This is the server DreamsFeather of Minecraft. Use the client we provide to get the best experience on the server. While using it, please pay attention to the usage agreements and redistribution requirements of various mods, and do not violate the agreements. You are welcome to join our Tencent QQ group (339212469) to participate and connect with fellow players. Thank you for your cooperation, and we wish you a pleasant experience.
- 这是我的世界梦落空羽服务器的客户端，使用我们提供的客户端以获得服务器内最佳的体验，当您使用过程中，请注意各类mod的使用协议以及二次分发的要求，请勿违反协议，您可加入我们的腾讯QQ群：339212469参与我们的游玩，感谢您的配合，祝您生活愉快
- allmusic.jar is not available for download on Modrinth, so we have provided the open-source link. We strictly adhere to the GPL-v3 license, make all code publicly available, and present to you the open-source repository of this mod.
- allmusic.jar因在Modrinth上没有下载渠道，故附上开源链接，我们严格遵守GPL-v3协议，公开所有代码，并且向您展示该mod的开源仓库
## Client Usage Tutorial 客户端使用教程
1. - Download the mrpack file we provide and choose the version that best suits your needs. For mobile devices, it is recommended to select the minimum required package, while the full package is available for computer users（This maybe not）.
   - 下载我们提供的mrpack文件，自行选择您最需要的版本
2. - Drag the mrpack file into your launcher, or select the "Import Modpack" button (or a similar option) in the launcher to import the downloaded mrpack file. Then, follow the prompts in the launcher to complete the setup.
   - 将mrpack文件拖入您的启动器，或选择启动器的导入整合包等类型的按钮，导入您下载的mrpack文件，并按照启动器提示完成设置
3. - Launch your game. Congratulations, you have completed the installation process for DreamsFeather client. Thank you for choosing us, and we wish you a pleasant gaming experience.
   - 启动您的游戏，恭喜您完成了梦落空羽客户端的安装流程，感谢您的选择，祝您游戏愉快
